title: DuMateBench: Evaluating Autonomous Agents in Complex Real-World Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.26546v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly adopted to complete complex, multi-tool workflows in real-world settings. However, existing benchmarks typically separate tasks by application or capability and evaluate agents in environments that are cleaner and more stable than those encountered in practice. We introduce DuMateBench, a real-session benchmark reconstructed from anonymized and privacy-screened user sessions collected from a large-scale production agent platform. Each task preserves the relevant pre-solution interaction history, persistent configurations, and workspace state, and is then validated through human verification. The resulting benchmark comprises 200 tasks spanning 8 broad scenarios and 17 fine-grained capability categories, with most tasks requiring multiple capability coordination. translated_title: DuMateBench：评估复杂真实工作流中的自主代理
translated_abstract: 自主代理越来越多地被用于完成现实环境中复杂的多工具工作流。然而，现有的基准测试通常按应用或能力分离任务，并在比实际实践更清洁、更稳定的环境中评估代理。我们引入了DuMateBench，这是一个从大规模生产代理平台收集的匿名化和隐私筛选用户会话中重建的真实会话基准。每个任务保留了相关的解决前交互历史、持久配置和工作区状态，并通过人工验证进行确认。由此产生的基准包含200个任务，涵盖8个广泛场景和17个细粒度能力类别，大多数任务需要多种能力的协调。我们在隔离的Docker容器中执行这些任务，并注入三种形式的现实环境复杂性：信息不足、不稳定和动态变化。
tldr: 本文提出了DuMateBench，一个基于真实用户会话重建的基准，通过200个多能力任务和三种环境复杂性挑战，填补了代理评估在现实工作流中的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DuMateBench, a real-session benchmark reconstructed from production user sessions, with 200 multi-capability tasks and three forms of environmental complexity, addressing the gap in evaluating agents in realistic workflows.
